answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a stake bond slashed only after peers co-sign a unique-human proof; a fake identity cluster needs one non-transferable bond per mask, so minting ten thousand socks costs ten thousand locked bonds, not one. Each identity also drains a plume of fees, and bonds are sealed like crystal in vaults unlockable only at burn, so the capital is truly sunk. Sable shadow accounts earn nothing extra because payouts split by verified identity stake, not address count. A fake identity thus costs more than it can earn, so the attack stays unprofitable at scale.
